scope: Native desktop OpenGL reference at the browser-captured camera in game/airdefense1. Fresh map with auto-skipped cinematic, not restoration of the browser-local save and not a pixel-identical campaign-state comparison.

source.method: Separate detached worktrees; no browser compatibility patches in native renderer. Built client and SP module using GCC 15.3 and system SDL3/OpenAL. Pinned pak0/pak1 reused.

runtime.renderer: AMD Radeon 890M Graphics (radeonsi, strix1, ACO, DRM 3.64, 7.1.8+deb14.1-amd64)

findings.rock: The dark triangular opening under the sloping central rock is also present in native rendering; this specific shape is not evidence of a browser geometry hole.
findings.background: Native rendering has a bright cloudy sky and distant structures, while the comparable browser view is largely black above the wall. This narrows the remaining investigation to sky/background rendering.
findings.limits: Native screenshot is smaller with nearly matching aspect ratio, at a different campaign time with different dynamic actors/effects. No exact pixel comparison or full renderer acceptance.
findings.warning: SDL offscreen relative-mouse-mode warnings are expected for this native reference and are not browser input errors.
findings.preservation: Browser session stayed paused. Native captures and generated asset caches are under the isolated temporary directory; live services, browser settings and retail assets were not modified.
